name: Crack Chicken and Rice Casserole
author: Brittany Biddy
steps: Cook and chop the chicken breast to yield about 2 cups.
Thinly slice or shred the carrots to yield about 1 cup.
Finely dice the bell pepper and onion to yield about 1/2 cup each.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Cook the rice a roni according to package directions, adding the carrots, bell pepper and onion in the last 5 minutes of cooking.
When the rice is cooked through, stir in the cream soup, sour cream, chicken breast and black pepper. Remove from heat.
Spread the rice mixture evenly in the prepared baking dish. Cover evenly with cheese.
Bake uncovered for 30 minutes then serve!
